changeSet.author: rtrilluru
changeSet.comment: View for APEX Customer Portal — summary with status
changeSet.createView: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_EMAIL, c.CUSTOMER_PHONE, c.SOURCE_SYSTEM, c.CREATED_DATE, CASE WHEN c.CUSTOMER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.CUSTOMER_EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND c.CUSTOMER_PHONE IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETE' WHEN c.CUSTOMER_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE 'INCOMPLETE' END AS DATA_STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TGT_CUSTOMER_AUDIT a WHERE a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID) AS AUDIT_COUNT FROM TGT_CUSTOMER c
